author_role: AI candidate author, not independent reviewer or native-human certifier

candidates.source: This %1$s contains %2$s frames. AN Paint edits still images and does not preserve animation.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Broj kadrova u ovoj slici formata %1$s: %2$s. AN Paint uređuje statične slike i ne čuva animaciju."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Count-introducing wording avoids agreement with arbitrary exact or lower-bound count strings. %1$s remains the format; %2$s remains the complete count string. Still-image editing and loss of animation are explicit.
uncertainties: The out-of-scope formats22_at_least_frames remains English fallback (at least %1$d); composed lower-bound-count messages are therefore mixed-language and are not claimed fully localized.

candidates.source: This PNG has a separate default image. That image will be imported instead of the animated frames. Saving creates a still image.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Ova PNG slika ima zasebnu podrazumevanu sliku. Ona će biti uvezena umesto kadrova animacije. Čuvanjem se dobija statična slika."
candidates.semantic_rationale: The separate PNG default image, not the animation frames, is imported; subsequent saving creates a still image.

candidates.source: Only the first frame will be imported. Saving creates a still image.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Biće uvezen samo prvi kadar. Čuvanjem se dobija statična slika."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Only the first frame is imported; saving creates a still image, not a retained animation.

candidates.source: Animated image
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Animirana slika"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Names an animated image for the inspection dialog; not an instruction to animate or a promise to preserve animation.

candidates.source: This %1$s is too complex to confirm whether it contains multiple frames. AN Paint will open only a still image and will not preserve any animation.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Ova slika formata %1$s je previše složena da bi se potvrdilo da li sadrži više kadrova. AN Paint će otvoriti samo statičnu sliku i neće sačuvati nikakvu animaciju."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Inspection cannot establish whether multiple frames exist. Does not infer a single frame; only still-image opening and no animation preservation are promised.

candidates.source: Writes plain text using light and dark characters. View it in a monospaced font. This is a visual rendition; it cannot be reopened as the original image.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Zapisuje običan tekst pomoću svetlih i tamnih znakova. Prikažite ga fontom u kojem su svi znakovi iste širine. To je vizuelni prikaz; ne može se ponovo otvoriti kao izvorna slika."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Plain-text visual rendition uses light/dark characters and a monospaced font; explicitly not reopenable as the original image.

candidates.source: Open still image
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Otvori statičnu sliku"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Imperative action follows existing Open vocabulary and limits the opened result to a still image.

candidates.source: PDF pages are rendered at 144 dpi. Text and vector objects become pixels.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "PDF stranice se prikazuju u rezoluciji od 144 dpi. Tekst i vektorski objekti pretvaraju se u piksele."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Retains fixed 144 dpi rendering and conversion of text and vector objects into pixels.

candidates.source: Still image, up to 256 colours. Dithering smooths colour gradients. Animated GIFs open as their first frame.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Statična slika sa najviše 256 boja. Didering ublažava prelaze između boja. Animirane GIF slike otvaraju se kao prvi kadar animacije."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Uses the inherited Dithering label vocabulary; preserves the 256-colour limit, gradient smoothing and first-frame-only GIF import.

candidates.source: Enter a file name without slashes or control characters.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Unesite naziv datoteke bez kosih crta i kontrolnih znakova."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Rejects slash and control characters without asserting that every other filename is accepted.

candidates.source: Higher quality preserves more detail and usually makes a larger file.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Viši kvalitet čuva više detalja i obično stvara veću datoteku."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Higher quality preserves more detail; a larger file is usual, not guaranteed.

candidates.source: This image uses a colour profile that AN Paint cannot convert yet. Convert it to sRGB PNG in a colour-managed editor before importing.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Ova slika koristi profil boja koji AN Paint još ne može da konvertuje. Pre uvoza je pretvorite u PNG sliku sa profilom sRGB u uređivaču koji podržava upravljanje bojama."
candidates.semantic_rationale: AN Paint cannot yet convert the profile. Instructs actual conversion to sRGB PNG in a colour-managed editor before import, not relabelling.

candidates.source: Higher quality usually makes a larger file. Lossless keeps every colour value.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Viši kvalitet obično stvara veću datoteku. Kompresija bez gubitaka (Lossless) čuva svaku vrednost boje."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Explains lossless compression while retaining the untouched English mode label Lossless for identification. Every colour value is retained; file-size increase remains usual, not certain.

candidates.source: %1$s A separate recovery copy has been kept. Use File > Export recovery copy to save its ZIP. Extract canvas.png from it and load that image to use the normal resize options if needed.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "%1$s Zasebna kopija za oporavak je sačuvana. Koristite „Datoteka > Izvezi kopiju za oporavak…“ da sačuvate njenu ZIP arhivu. Izdvojite canvas.png iz nje i otvorite tu sliku da biste po potrebi koristili uobičajene opcije za promenu veličine."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Preserves prefixed failure detail plus distinct success of retaining a separate recovery copy. Exact current File and recovery-export labels; literal ZIP/canvas.png and optional ordinary resize workflow retained.

candidates.source: Autosave failed · use Save
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Automatsko čuvanje nije uspelo · koristite „Sačuvaj“"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Failed autosave status directs to the exact current Save action; not a successful manual save.

candidates.source: Autosave image encoding failed.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Kodiranje slike za automatsko čuvanje nije uspelo."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Encoding of the autosave image failed; no implication that a different save step failed or succeeded.

candidates.source: %1$s Autosave is paused to protect that draft. Use “File → Export recovery copy…” to keep it, and “File → Save as…” (File format: PNG / JPEG) to save your current work.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "%1$s Automatsko čuvanje je pauzirano radi zaštite te radne verzije. Da biste je zadržali, koristite „Datoteka → Izvezi kopiju za oporavak…“. Da biste sačuvali trenutni rad, koristite „Datoteka → Sačuvaj kao…“ (Format slike: PNG / JPEG)."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Failure detail is preserved at the start. Autosave is paused to protect the prior draft; recovery export retains that draft, whereas Save as saves current work in PNG/JPEG. Current action labels remain verbatim. Cyrillic explicitly identifies its inherited, semantically incorrect field label rather than presenting that label as a translation of format.

candidates.source: Autosave metadata is missing.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nedostaju metapodaci automatski sačuvane radne verzije."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Missing metadata belongs to the autosaved draft, not to the explicit image destination.

candidates.source: Autosave paused · use Save
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Automatsko čuvanje je pauzirano · koristite „Sačuvaj“"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Paused, not failed or completed, autosave directs to the exact current Save label.

candidates.source: Autosave pixels are missing.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nedostaju pikseli automatski sačuvane radne verzije."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Missing pixel data in the autosaved draft is distinct from metadata absence and unreadable existing pixels.

candidates.source: Autosave pixels could not be read.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nije moguće pročitati piksele automatski sačuvane radne verzije."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Reports unreadable autosave pixels without asserting they are absent or recoverable.

candidates.source: Autosave selection encoding failed.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Kodiranje izbora za automatsko čuvanje nije uspelo."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Autosave selection encoding, rather than the canvas image encoding, failed; selection vocabulary follows existing UI.

candidates.source: Cannot create the undo cache. Free some device storage and try again.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nije moguće napraviti keš za opoziv. Oslobodite prostor za skladištenje na uređaju i pokušajte ponovo."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Cannot create the disk-backed undo cache; explicitly asks for device storage space, not additional RAM, and retries.

candidates.source: Could not export the recovery copy
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Izvoz kopije za oporavak nije uspeo"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Failure prefix for ioFailed retains recovery-copy export meaning and has no added terminal punctuation.

candidates.source: Draft not saved yet
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Radna verzija još nije sačuvana"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Draft status says not saved yet; does not claim manual Save failed or that the draft can never be saved.

candidates.source: Draft restored
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Radna verzija je vraćena"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Reports restoration of the draft only; no assertion that all undo history was recovered.

candidates.source: Draft saved
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Radna verzija je sačuvana"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Autosave draft status, explicitly a working draft rather than the manually saved image or a cleared dirty state.

candidates.source: Export recovery copy
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Izvezi kopiju za oporavak"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Exactly the inherited recovery-export action vocabulary, with only its ellipsis removed for the canonical dialog title.

candidates.source: The canvas was restored, but its undo history could not be read. The original draft has been kept as a recovery copy.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Platno je vraćeno, ali njegovu istoriju opoziva nije moguće pročitati. Izvorna radna verzija je sačuvana kao kopija za oporavak."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Separates successful canvas restoration, unreadable undo history and retention of the original draft as a recovery copy. formatted=false retained.

candidates.source: Invalid autosave metadata.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Metapodaci automatski sačuvane radne verzije nisu ispravni."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Invalid metadata in the autosaved draft; does not substitute missing metadata or imply a repair occurred.

candidates.source: Previous draft kept for recovery
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Prethodna radna verzija je zadržana za oporavak"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Prior draft retained for recovery, not restored and not a statement that current work was saved.

candidates.source: Recovered image
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Oporavljena slika"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Generic recovered-image filename/title; not a new format name or a guarantee about restored history.

candidates.source: Recovery copy exported. Extract canvas.png from the ZIP and open it with File > Load image. The ZIP also contains draft settings and any floating selection.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Kopija za oporavak je izvezena. Izdvojite canvas.png iz ZIP arhive i otvorite ga pomoću „Datoteka > Otvori sliku…“. ZIP arhiva sadrži i podešavanja radne verzije i plutajući izbor, ako postoji."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Export success precedes ZIP extraction of literal canvas.png. Uses actual existing Open image label rather than literal English Load image; archive also has draft settings and any floating selection.

candidates.source: The draft is saving. Try again shortly.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Čuvanje radne verzije je u toku. Pokušajte ponovo uskoro."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Draft save is in progress and temporarily blocks the attempted operation; asks for a short wait/retry, not another Save action.

candidates.source: The previous draft could not be moved to a recovery copy.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Prethodnu radnu verziju nije moguće premestiti u kopiju za oporavak."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Move of the prior draft to a recovery copy failed; no claim that a recovery copy exists.

candidates.source: The previous draft could not be preserved separately.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Prethodnu radnu verziju nije moguće sačuvati zasebno."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Separate preservation of the prior draft failed, distinct from successful separate retention and from current-image saving.

candidates.source: The previous draft could not be restored.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Prethodnu radnu verziju nije moguće vratiti."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Prior draft restoration failed; no claim that it was deleted or that all recovery is impossible.

candidates.source: The previous draft needs more memory to reopen.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Za ponovno otvaranje prethodne radne verzije potrebno je više memorije."
candidates.semantic_rationale: More working memory is needed to reopen the previous draft; does not request disk space or claim corruption.

candidates.source: The undo cache is damaged.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Keš za opoziv je oštećen."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Undo cache corruption, not a successful cache repair or generic image corruption.

candidates.source: Unexpected data in the undo cache.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Neočekivani podaci u kešu za opoziv."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Unexpected data specifically in the undo cache; no implied loss of all canvas pixels.

candidates.source: An assembly source image is missing.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nedostaje jedna izvorna slika za kompoziciju."
candidates.semantic_rationale: A source image of the assembly layout is missing; the candidate does not say the rendered output is missing. Composition denotes the assembled layout, not a renamed action label.

candidates.source: Assembly saved
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Kompozicija je sačuvana"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Assembly output save success only; does not assert an editable interchange format or an updated main-editor Save target.

candidates.source: This assembly is estimated to exceed the current working-memory budget, even at the smallest output size. Reducing the assembly dimensions alone is not enough under the current limits. Close other documents or prepare a smaller source image before trying again. Your assembly is unchanged.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Procenjuje se da je za ovu kompoziciju potrebno više radne memorije nego što trenutno ograničenje dozvoljava, čak i pri najmanjoj veličini izlazne slike. Samo smanjenje dimenzija kompozicije nije dovoljno pri trenutnim ograničenjima. Zatvorite druge dokumente ili pripremite manju izvornu sliku pre nego što pokušate ponovo. Vaša kompozicija je nepromenjena."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Preserves estimated combined assembly memory, current limits, smallest output still exceeding them, insufficient dimension reduction alone, both alternatives and unchanged assembly. Not a universal impossibility or decoder-only statement.
uncertainties: The related P1 ui_no_resize_fits_decoder_memory remains absent and unreviewed. This P0 candidate does not confer acceptance on the paired P1 warning; implementation/test receipts must keep the scopes separate.

candidates.source: Clear all
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Očisti sve"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Matches inherited Clear vocabulary; applies to all assembly contents, not only one selected image.

candidates.source: Could not save the assembly: %1$s
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Čuvanje kompozicije nije uspelo: %1$s"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Assembly output write failed; exact string placeholder carries the original exception detail.

candidates.source: Could not store the assembly.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Skladištenje kompozicije nije uspelo."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Failure to persist internal assembly data is distinguished from writing an exported PNG output.

candidates.source: %1$d × %2$d pixels (%3$.2f MP) exceeds the current safe editing budget of %4$.2f MP. AN Paint keeps the complete image in memory and reserves space for transforms and selections. Available memory determines this budget. The operation was stopped before allocating the oversized bitmap. No automatic resizing was applied.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Slika dimenzija %1$d × %2$d piksela (%3$.2f MP) premašuje trenutno ograničenje za bezbedno uređivanje od %4$.2f MP. AN Paint drži celu sliku u memoriji i rezerviše prostor za transformacije i izbore. Ovo ograničenje zavisi od raspoložive memorije. Operacija je zaustavljena pre dodele memorije za preveliku bitmapu. Veličina nije automatski promenjena."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Width, height, image megapixels and permitted megapixels retain exact order/types/precision and multiplication sign. Full image plus editing reserves, available-memory dependency, stop before oversized allocation and no automatic resize retained.

candidates.source: Keeps pixels at the top left. Smaller canvas dimensions discard pixels beyond the right/bottom edge; Undo restores them.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Zadržava piksele u gornjem levom uglu. Manje dimenzije platna odbacuju piksele izvan desne i donje ivice; opcija „Opozovi“ ih vraća."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Canvas resize anchors retained pixels top-left; right/bottom out-of-bounds pixels are discarded and the exact current Undo action restores them.

candidates.source: Not enough memory for this operation. The assembly source files are retained.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nema dovoljno memorije za ovu operaciju. Izvorne datoteke kompozicije su zadržane."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Assembly operation lacks memory but source files are retained; no claim of successful operation or saved output.

candidates.source: Resize large image?
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Promeniti veličinu velike slike?"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Question about resizing a large image; follows inherited image-size vocabulary without suggesting automatic resizing already occurred.

candidates.source: Estimates include the current canvas and clipboard, sampled decoding and editing buffers. Actual memory use varies. A smaller copy loses detail. The original file stays unchanged.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Procene obuhvataju trenutno platno i sadržaj ostave, dekodiranje u smanjenoj rezoluciji i bafere za uređivanje. Stvarna potrošnja memorije varira. Manja kopija gubi detalje. Izvorna datoteka ostaje nepromenjena."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Memory estimate includes current canvas, clipboard, reduced-resolution sampled decode and editing buffers; actual use varies, smaller copy loses detail, original file unchanged. Applies only to non-native-work branch.

candidates.source: Save PNG
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Sačuvaj PNG"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Assembly PNG output action uses current Save vocabulary; does not change the separate drawing editor destination.

candidates.source: The saved assembly could not be opened: %1$s
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Sačuvanu kompoziciju nije moguće otvoriti: %1$s"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Failure to reopen stored assembly metadata, with exact exception-detail placeholder and no claim that rendering succeeded.

candidates.source: The trim would remove the entire image.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Ovim obrezivanjem bi se uklonila cela slika."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Conditional destructive consequence of the rejected trim; the image has not already been removed.

candidates.source: There is not enough memory for this operation at the original resolution. No automatic resizing was applied.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nema dovoljno memorije za ovu operaciju u izvornoj rezoluciji. Veličina nije automatski promenjena."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Operation lacks memory at original resolution, explicitly with no automatic resizing applied.

candidates.source: The image credits could not be saved or restored. Existing saved credits have been kept. Try again.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Podatke o autorima i izvorima slika nije moguće sačuvati ili vratiti. Postojeći sačuvani podaci su zadržani. Pokušajte ponovo."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Credits are attribution/source information, not money or only author names. Save/restore failure, retained existing stored credits and retry are all explicit.

candidates.source: These image credits would make the drawing too large to restore. Your previous drawing and credits have been kept.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Zbog ovih podataka o autorima i izvorima slika, količina podataka u crtežu bila bi prevelika za vraćanje. Vaš prethodni crtež i podaci o autorima i izvorima slika su zadržani."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Too much attribution metadata would make the drawing unrestorable; explicitly refers to data volume, not pixel dimensions, and retains prior drawing plus prior credits.

candidates.source: Some saved credits could not be read. Their stored copies have been kept.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Neke sačuvane podatke o autorima i izvorima slika nije moguće pročitati. Njihove sačuvane kopije su zadržane."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Some stored attribution data are unreadable, but their stored copies remain; does not assert that all credits restored or unreadable copies are usable.

candidates.source: The completed image could not replace its destination.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Odredišnu datoteku nije bilo moguće zameniti gotovom slikom."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Encoded image completion is distinct from failed destination-file replacement/rename; not a completed provider write.

candidates.source: The image and encoding buffers exceed the export memory budget.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Slika i baferi za kodiranje premašuju ograničenje memorije za izvoz."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Combined image plus encoding buffers exceed the export working-memory budget; neither disk-file size nor canvas footprint alone.

candidates.source: Could not open image
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Otvaranje slike nije uspelo"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Image-opening failure prefix without final punctuation; caller appends exception/fallback details.

candidates.source: Could not save image
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Čuvanje slike nije uspelo"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Image-save failure prefix without final punctuation or invented placeholder; caller supplies separator and error detail.

candidates.source: The export was created. Use Save or Save as to save the current image before continuing.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Izvezena datoteka je napravljena. Pre nego što nastavite, koristite „Sačuvaj“ ili „Sačuvaj kao…“ da sačuvate trenutnu sliku."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Export output was created successfully but does not satisfy save-before-replacement. Both exact current Save actions must still save the current image before continuing.

candidates.source: Export an icon, Base64 text or ASCII art. Exporting keeps the current image and its Save destination unchanged.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Izvezite ikonu, Base64 tekst ili ASCII crtež. Izvoz ne menja trenutnu sliku niti njeno odredište za opciju „Sačuvaj“."
candidates.semantic_rationale: All three derived export types retained; neither the working image nor its Save target changes. Does not deny that a separate export file is written.

candidates.source: Not enough memory to save in this format. Try PNG
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nema dovoljno memorije za čuvanje u ovom formatu. Pokušajte sa PNG formatom"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Insufficient memory in selected format; PNG is a suggestion, not a guaranteed remedy. No terminal period because caller appends details.

candidates.source: PNG encoding failed.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "PNG kodiranje nije uspelo."
candidates.semantic_rationale: PNG encoding failure only; not a successful save or a false report about decoder support.

candidates.source: Save and share
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Sačuvaj i podeli"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Exactly the inherited Save and share action vocabulary with only the ellipsis removed; existing explanation remains untouched.

candidates.source: Choose an image format and its compression settings. Save will reuse this file name, location, format and settings.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Izaberite format slike i podešavanja kompresije. Opcija „Sačuvaj“ će ponovo koristiti ovaj naziv datoteke, lokaciju, format i podešavanja."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Choose image format/compression; later exact Save action reuses all four items: filename, location, format and settings. No claim that compression is always lossy.

candidates.source: Saved %1$s
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Sačuvano: %1$s"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Named output file was saved; same neutral toast can describe Save, Export or Share writes without asserting all document changes are saved. Exactly one indexed string token retained.

candidates.source: The encoder did not finish.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Kodiranje nije dovršeno."
candidates.semantic_rationale: The image encoding process did not finish; avoids an ambiguous human coder and makes no output-success claim.

candidates.source: The image was saved, but Android could not open sharing: %1$s
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Slika je sačuvana, ali Android nije mogao da pokrene deljenje: %1$s"
candidates.semantic_rationale: Successful image-copy write and failed Android sharing launch remain separate; exception placeholder retained, with no Save-target change claim.

candidates.source: The selected location is not writable.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nije moguće upisivati na izabranu lokaciju."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Chosen location cannot accept writes; does not invent permissions-only or write-protection cause.

candidates.source: This location is not writable.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Nije moguće upisivati na ovu lokaciju."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Generic unwritable location applicable to recovery/source-code export; no narrower cause or unrelated archive-identity change.

candidates.source: Your current image has unsaved changes.
candidates.proposed_xml_text: "Vaša trenutna slika ima nesačuvane izmene."
candidates.semantic_rationale: Current working image has unsaved changes; negation and current-document scope retained rather than referring to a prior draft.
